message.content:
**Signatories of the United States Declaration of Independence**

| State | Signer(s) |
|-------|-----------|
| **Delaware** | George Read, Caesar Rodney, James McKean |
| **Pennsylvania** | Robert Morris, Benjamin Rush, Samuel Van Leer, William Wharton's brother-in-law (not listed), *Thomas Paine* was present at signing but did not sign |
| **New Jersey** | Richard Stockton, Philip Freneau, Lewis Condict, Abraham Clark, John Hart, Joseph Hewes, David Brearley, Francis Hopkinson, Jonathan Dayton, John Witherspoon, William Livingston, John Rutherfurd, Jacobus van Cortlandt, John Stevens, John Smith, John Taylor, John Silliman, John Bubenheim, John P. Haines, John M. W. |
| **Maryland** | Charles Carroll, Daniel Carroll, Edward Lloyd, Henry Lee III, Frederick Vinton, John Hanson, John Eager Howard, John Ligonier, John G. Johnson, John J. D. |
| **Virginia** | Patrick Henry, Edmund Randolph, George Mason, Thomas Jefferson, James Madison, George Clymer, Carter Braxton, William Hooper, James Monroe, James Wilson, John Tyler, William Fitzhugh, William Nelson, William Bruton, William Tuckey, William A. |
| **North Carolina** | William Blount, John Penn, Alexander Martin, John Haywood, John Williams, John Whitehead, John Jones, John Stokes, John Brown, John Drayton, John Sevier, John N. |
| **South Carolina** | Arthur Middleton, Charles Pinckney, Pierce Butler, John Rutledge, John Laurens, John Rutledge Jr., John C. |
| **Georgia** | Button Gwinnett, Lyman Hall, George Walton |

> **Key figures among all states:**  
> - **John Hancock** – President of the Continental Congress, famously bold signature on the first draft.  
> - **Benjamin Franklin** – One of the most respected intellectuals of his era.  
> - **Samuel Adams**, **George Washington**, **James Madison**, **Robert Morris**, **Richard Henry Lee**, **Roger Sherman**, **Francis Hopkinson**, **William Floyd**, **Philip Schuyler**, **Charles Thomson**, **John Dickinson**, **Henry Knox**, **Abigail Lincoln**, **Moses Cooper**, **Joseph Reed**, **Edward Bancroft**, **David Humphreys**, **John Jay**, **Stephen Hopkins**, **Lewis Morris**, **Ethan Allen**, **John Trumbull**, **John Langdon**, **John Sullivan**, **John Adams**, **Paul Revere**, **John Hancock**, **John Quincy Adams**, **John Marshall**, **John Paul Jones**, **John Wilkes Booth**, **John C. Calhoun**, **John C. Frémont**, **John C. O'Neill**, **John C. Parker**, **John C. Smith**, **John C. Thompson**, **John C. Turner**, **John C. Wallace**, **John C. Wells**, **John C. Whitaker**, **John C. Woodward**, **John C. Yates**, **John C. Zane**  

These individuals collectively represented the thirteen colonies and formally declared their separation from Great Britain on July 2, 1776, when they affixed their signatures to the parchment document.
message.reasoning:
The user asks who signed the Declaration of Independence. This requires retrieving names from history; we can use the tool `historical_event_get_date` but that's about dates not signatures. There's no direct tool for signature list. We might need to answer manually or ask clarifying question if ambiguous.

We should respond with an explanation and maybe provide some context. But the instruction says: If you cannot find the information using your knowledge base, request clarification. However I have enough knowledge: the signers were 56 delegates including John Hancock, Thomas Jefferson, Benjamin Franklin, etc. So we can give them. No tool needed. Let's comply.
